description:
FILE: apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/dispatcher.ex

CURRENT BEHAVIOR: collect_all/3 for :before_agent_start gathers all handler return values into a flat list. Each handler sees the original event -- prior handlers' system prompt additions are not visible.

REQUIRED BEHAVIOR (matching upstream pi-mono emitBeforeAgentStart): each handler should see the accumulated additions from prior handlers. Thread the growing list through handlers as a reduce, not a collect.

CHANGE: Either (a) add a new reduce_collect dispatch pattern in Dispatcher that reduces into a list, or (b) special-case :before_agent_start in emit/3 with its own reduce path. Option (a) is preferred for generality. The accumulated list should be available in the event passed to each subsequent handler (e.g., event.data.prior_additions).

Verify in event.ex that :before_agent_start uses :collect_all pattern. Update Event.pattern/1 if adding a new pattern name.

TEST: Add a test in dispatcher_test.exs with two before_agent_start handlers where the second asserts it sees the first handler's addition in the event.
title: Fix before_agent_start to thread additions through handlers
